summary: Iteration 27: tested 'MSG91 OTP off' mode with backend pytest and Playwright at 390x844. Everything requested passes. GET /api/auth/otp/status returns enabled=false. /auth opens in email mode and shows no 'Use mobile number' toggle. The password eye works in both login and register (type changes password -> text -> password). A fresh TEST user registered through the UI (name, email, password, consent; missing consent shows an error) and was logged in on Home. The Profile 'Verify your mobile number' card is hidden. The local driver wizard shows no pro-phone-warning and its personal card reads 'No mobile number'. Languages is a dropdown: pro-lang-options opens with 24 languages, picking one closes the list and adds an orange chip, picked languages leave the list, tapping a chip removes it and returns it to the list, and Continue without a language shows 'Select at least one language'. The full wizard (Hiriyur via location search, Kannada, licence, rent only) submitted to 'Verification pending' for the no-phone user. The carpool manual verification form shows 'Mobile number is optional for now', has no Add button, and submitted to Under review. On the backend, /pro/register and /driver/verification work without a phone; other checks (docs, consent, empty languages 422, expired licence) still apply.

issues: Field order is Email, Password, Full name. Name usually comes first; consider moving it to the top (minor UX).

critical_code_review_comments: useOtp.ts caches the enabled flag at module level for the whole app session, so turning MSG91 on needs an app reload. Acceptable, but note it.
The auth register/login switch links had no testIDs. Testing agent added auth-register-link and auth-login-link.
When OTP is enabled later, mode still defaults to 'email'. Confirm this is intended.
